top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A sampling of children records were evaluated. One child's immunization record was observed incomplete.

top_violation_types.title: Required Records Storage (26 TAC §746.803(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not keep infant feeding plans on file for 3 months.

top_violation_types.title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Multiple infants were observed in bucket chairs without the provided straps being used.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two infants did not have current infant feeding schedules.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Unassigned Epinephrine Auto-Injectors (26 TAC §746.501(a)(29))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Operational Policies did state if operation will administer unassigned epinephrine auto injectors.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The staff files reviewed did not have the required Health and Safety training topic certificates for the last full year of training.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Support inclusive services (26 TAC §746.501(a)(30))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policies were lacking information related to the support of inclusive services.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Release Information (26 TAC §746.605(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's records did not have the release information filled out.
